beats.anchor: Douze melons roulent dans toutes les directions
beats.extras: A supermarket worker, about 40, stocky, pale skin, shaved head, plain green apron with no logo, on his knees with his arms full of melons, out of breath. In the background, a few blurred shoppers turning their heads.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in a grey tracksuit, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot showing above white sneakers, small soft afro. Maman Estelle in a warm coat over her teal and yellow wax-print dress, braids gathered in a bun, big golden earrings, pushing a shopping trolley.
beats.action: A pyramid of melons has just collapsed. Twelve melons roll in every direction across the floor like footballs after training. Kaydoudou, on all fours, dives to catch them, arms full, eyes huge, the gap in his teeth showing in a guilty grin. The worker catches the others. Maman stands behind the trolley, turning her face away as if she does not know him, her shoulders shaking with held-back laughter.
beats.location: The fruit aisle of a big French suburban supermarket, crates of apples and oranges, a tiled floor, price tags with no readable writing.
beats.light: Bright white supermarket lighting, colourful fruit, shiny floor reflections.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle at floor level, melons rolling toward the viewer, Kaydoudou diving in the middle, Maman upright and hiding her laugh at the back.
beats.alt: Au supermarché, la pyramide de melons s'écroule ; Kaydoudou, à quatre pattes, les rattrape pendant que Maman fait semblant de ne pas le connaître.

beats.anchor: Lacombe marche jusqu'au milieu du vide.
beats.extras: Monsieur Bertrand Lacombe, 55, pale skin, short grey hair, a thick grey moustache trimmed like a shoe brush, navy tracksuit, a metal whistle on a lace, standing alone in the empty strip of grass, one arm stretched out to show the space. Eight boys of 12 and 13 in yellow training bibs, mixed skin tones (pale, olive, brown, dark), standing in two straight rows of four, ten metres apart.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in the white ESM training shirt with a small star on the heart, dark shorts, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, small soft afro.
beats.action: Between the two rows of yellow bibs, Lacombe stands in the middle of the empty grass and points at the ground around him with a serious face. Kaydoudou, on tiptoe at the edge, stares at the empty strip with wide shining eyes, his mouth slowly opening as he understands that this place is made for him.
beats.location: An artificial training pitch at the ESM centre by the river Marne, a white building with a large painted star in the background.
beats.light: Cool autumn afternoon light, pale sky, long soft shadows on the bright green turf.
beats.camera: Wide shot from slightly above, the two yellow rows framing the empty band of grass, Lacombe at its centre, Kaydoudou small and bright on the left.
beats.alt: Entre deux rangées de chasubles jaunes, Monsieur Lacombe montre l'espace vide, et Kaydoudou comprend que cet endroit est fait pour lui.

beats.extras: Lucas Morel, 13, straw-coloured hair, red cheeks, big hands, white ESM kit, shouting with both hands around his mouth behind Kaydoudou. Kenzo Delattre, 13, brown curls, very white boots, white ESM kit with number 8 on the back, starting his run on the left. Two Trois-Moulins defenders, about 13, one pale with short fair hair, one brown-skinned with short black hair, in dark red shirts, rushing at Kaydoudou like panicked hens.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in the white ESM shirt with the star on the heart and number 7 on the back, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot. BriBri far behind in the white ESM shirt, seen from the front so no number shows, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist.
beats.action: Kaydoudou has just received the ball between the lines and turned toward goal in one move, eyes wide and bright, the gap in his teeth showing in a fierce grin. Two defenders throw themselves at him from both sides. Kenzo sprints into the space on the left, and Kaydoudou's foot is already sliding the ball between the two defenders toward him. Behind, Lucas yells, and far back BriBri watches with his head up.
beats.location: A suburban grass pitch on a grey Saturday, a white rail around it, a snack stand blurred in the background.
beats.light: Soft grey overcast light, cool colours, the white kits glowing, Kaydoudou's red and yellow socks the brightest spots.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle in front of Kaydoudou, the ball at the centre, the two defenders converging, Kenzo's run cutting diagonally on the left, Lucas and BriBri small behind.
beats.alt: Entre les lignes, Kaydoudou se retourne comme une souris dans un mur, et Lucas crie « La souris ! » derrière lui.
